Ronald dela Rosa, wanted over involvement in Duterte’s ‘war on drugs’, reportedly left heavily guarded building before dawn A Philippine lawmaker wanted by the international criminal court for his alleged role enforcing Rodrigo Duterte’s bloody anti-drugs crackdown has secretly fled the senate, after spending days holed up in the building to avoid arrest. The senate president, Alan Peter Cayetano, confirmed to the media that senator Ronald dela Rosa was “no longer in the building”, after reports that he had slipped out of the heavily guarded building before dawn. “I’m waiting for a complete incident report on what time he left,” Cayetano said.

Dela Rosa’s disappearance follows a dramatic week in which he earlier avoided arrest by outrunning government agents as they chased him through the hallways and staircases of the senate. When he reached the building’s chamber, he was given protective custody by the senate president, a longtime Duterte ally. Dela Rosa had remained in the building for days, but chaos erupted on Wednesday when he announced his arrest was imminent and called upon his supporters to gather outside, leading to a heavy security presence at the building. Gunshots were later fired in the senate, forcing journalists to scramble for cover. Senate security personnel and National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) personnel exchanged fire, according to an official from the president’s office. Police are investigating the incident.

At a press conference on Thursday, Cayetano read a text message he had been sent by Dela Rosa’s wife in which she thanked senators for their support and apologised for the “confusion and havoc” caused. “It is for this reason I am sure that Ronald made his ‘escape’,” the message added, according to Cayetano, who said “escape” was written in quotation marks. “He told me that the longer he stays inside the senate, the more all of you will be dragged into the situation. We know that the NBI, the CIDG [Criminal Investigation and Detection Group], the police, or even the military would not storm the senate if he were not inside,” the message continued.

[Lähde: The Guardian World]
Ronald dela Rosa, wanted over involvement in Duterte’s ‘war on drugs’, reportedly left heavily guarded building before dawn

A Philippine lawmaker wanted by the international criminal court for his alleged role enforcing Rodrigo Duterte’s bloody anti-drugs crackdown has secretly fled the senate, after spending days holed up in the building to avoid arrest.

The senate president, Alan Peter Cayetano, confirmed to the media that senator Ronald dela Rosa was “no longer in the building”, after reports that he had slipped out of the heavily guarded building before dawn.

“I’m waiting for a complete incident report on what time he left,” Cayetano said.

Dela Rosa’s disappearance follows a dramatic week in which he earlier avoided arrest by outrunning government agents as they chased him through the hallways and staircases of the senate. When he reached the building’s chamber, he was given protective custody by the senate president, a longtime Duterte ally.

Dela Rosa had remained in the building for days, but chaos erupted on Wednesday when he announced his arrest was imminent and called upon his supporters to gather outside, leading to a heavy security presence at the building. Gunshots were later fired in the senate, forcing journalists to scramble for cover.

Senate security personnel and National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) personnel exchanged fire, according to an official from the president’s office. Police are investigating the incident.

At a press conference on Thursday, Cayetano read a text message he had been sent by Dela Rosa’s wife in which she thanked senators for their support and apologised for the “confusion and havoc” caused. “It is for this reason I am sure that Ronald made his ‘escape’,” the message added, according to Cayetano, who said “escape” was written in quotation marks.

“He told me that the longer he stays inside the senate, the more all of you will be dragged into the situation. We know that the NBI, the CIDG [Criminal Investigation and Detection Group], the police, or even the military would not storm the senate if he were not inside,” the message continued.

The Philippines president, Ferdinand Marcos Jr, has said there were no instructions to arrest Dela Rosa and questioned whether the event was an attempt to “destabilise the government or trigger chaos”.

Marcos is embroiled in a fierce feud with the Duterte family, which intensified last year when the former leader Duterte was arrested and transferred to the ICC.

payload.title: ICC:n etsintäkuuluttama filippiiniläissenaattori poistui senaatista salaa
payload.summary: Filippiiniläinen senaattori Ronald dela Rosa on poistunut senaatin rakennuksesta oltuaan siellä useita päiviä suojassa pidätysyritykseltä. Häntä etsitään kansainvälisen rikostuomioistuimen tutkintaan liittyen Rodrigo Duterten huumeidenvastaisen kampanjan aikaisesta roolistaan.
payload.content:
Filippiiniläinen senaattori Ronald dela Rosa on poistunut salaa maan senaatin rakennuksesta oltuaan siellä useita päiviä välttääkseen pidätyksen. Kansainvälinen rikostuomioistuin etsii häntä hänen väitetystä roolistaan Rodrigo Duterten hallinnon verisen huumeidenvastaisen kampanjan toimeenpanossa.

## Senaatin puhemies vahvisti poistumisen

Senaatin puhemies Alan Peter Cayetano vahvisti medialle, ettei Ronald dela Rosa ollut enää rakennuksessa. Tietojen mukaan senaattori poistui vahvasti vartioidusta senaatista ennen aamunkoittoa. Cayetano sanoi odottavansa täydellistä tapahtumaraporttia siitä, mihin aikaan dela Rosa lähti.

Dela Rosa oli pysytellyt senaatin tiloissa useita päiviä sen jälkeen, kun hän oli aiemmin välttänyt pidätysyrityksen. Lähdetietojen mukaan hallituksen agentit jahtasivat häntä senaatin käytävillä ja portaikoissa, kunnes hän pääsi rakennuksen istuntosaliin. Sen jälkeen senaatin puhemies, jota kuvataan Duterten pitkäaikaiseksi liittolaiseksi, otti hänet senaatin suojelukseen.

## Kireä tilanne johti laukauksiin

Tilanne kärjistyi keskiviikkona, kun dela Rosa ilmoitti pidätyksensä olevan lähellä ja kehotti kannattajiaan kokoontumaan senaatin ulkopuolelle. Rakennukselle tuotiin tämän jälkeen runsaasti turvallisuushenkilöstöä. Myöhemmin senaatissa ammuttiin laukauksia, mikä pakotti paikalla olleita toimittajia hakeutumaan suojaan.

Presidentin kanslian virkamiehen mukaan senaatin turvallisuushenkilöstö ja kansallinen tutkintavirasto NBI vaihtoivat tulitusta. Poliisi tutkii tapahtunutta. Lähdepaketin mukaan tilanteessa mainittiin myös CIDG eli rikostutkinta- ja havaintoryhmä sekä poliisi ja armeija mahdollisina viranomaisina, joiden ei uskottu rynnäköivän senaattiin, ellei dela Rosa olisi rakennuksessa.

## Vaimon viesti selitti lähtöä

Torstain tiedotustilaisuudessa Cayetano luki viestin, jonka hän kertoi saaneensa dela Rosan vaimolta. Viestissä kiitettiin senaattoreita tuesta ja pahoiteltiin aiheutunutta sekasortoa. Cayetanon mukaan viestissä arvioitiin, että dela Rosa teki ”paon”, koska hänen jäämisensä senaattiin olisi vetänyt yhä useampia ihmisiä mukaan tilanteeseen.

Dela Rosan tapaus liittyy kansainvälisen rikostuomioistuimen toimiin, jotka koskevat Duterten huumeidenvastaista kampanjaa ja sen toimeenpanoa. Senaattorin tarkka poistumisaika ei ollut Cayetanon mukaan vielä selvillä, ja viranomaiset selvittävät sekä poistumista että senaatissa sattunutta tulitusta.
